importModel.title: Import Model
importModel.description: Import a GGUF model file to add it to your collection. Enable multimodal support to attach an mmproj for image or audio input, or draft model support for speculative decoding. Embedding models are detected automatically.
importModel.multimodalDescription: Enable if your model uses an mmproj for image or audio input. Modalities are detected from the projector file.
importModel.draftModelDescription: Attach a smaller draft model (including MTP draft heads) for speculative decoding. The draft model must share the main model's tokenizer and vocabulary.
importModel.embeddingDetectedDescription: This model will be imported for embeddings only. Multimodal options are disabled.

toast.selectBothFiles: Please select both model and MMPROJ files for multimodal models
toast.selectDraftFile: Please select a draft model file
toast.unableToDetermineName: Unable to determine model name from file

errors.clipAsTextModel: This model has CLIP architecture and cannot be imported as a text generation model. CLIP models are designed for vision tasks and require different handling.
errors.mmprojNotClip: This MMProj file has "{{arch}}" architecture but should have "clip" architecture. MMProj files must be CLIP models for vision or audio processing.
errors.draftIsClip: This file has CLIP architecture and cannot be used as a draft model.
errors.draftIncompatible: Draft model is not compatible with the main model: {{mismatch}}.
errors.tokenizerMismatch: tokenizer type "{{draftType}}" does not match the main model's tokenizer type "{{mainType}}"
errors.bosMismatch: BOS token id {{draftId}} does not match the main model's BOS token id {{mainId}}
errors.eosMismatch: EOS token id {{draftId}} does not match the main model's EOS token id {{mainId}}
errors.vocabMismatch: vocab size {{draftSize}} differs from the main model's vocab size {{mainSize}} by more than {{maxDiff}} tokens
